rules.description: Level per rule id, for example prose/plain-punctuation.

headingAllowlist.description: Names allowed to keep their capitals in headings.

sectionOrder.description: The set and order of second-level headings. An empty list turns the check off.

maxFindingsPerRule.description: Findings shown per rule before the rest are folded into one line. Default 10

denylistFile.description: File of sha256 hashes, one per line. Default .readmerlin/denylist.sha256

worksWith.description: The hosts the skill runs in, in order, drawn as the works-with badge row. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, Claude.ai, OpenCode and Windsurf get a badge; context names any other host for a badge by hand.

compare.description: The approved comparison: alternative repos as owner/repo, and the row labels, in order.

counts.description: Badge label to a shell command that prints the true number.
